currents.note: Battery current is phase current scaled by power factor ~0.92 at operating point

motor_electrical.note: R and L filled from final optimizer run; see performance.json

esc_requirements.temperature_sensor: NTC on winding end-turn plus MOSFET temperature via DRV8353S VDS sense

connections.motor_leads: 3 x silicone-insulated 12 AWG, 150 mm, bare ends
connections.termination: Option A: 4 mm bullet connectors; Option B (production): direct solder to ESC phase lugs

cooling.mounting_surface: still air acceptable at continuous rating due to open outrunner construction

duty.continuous: 60 A phase / 2200 W shaft indefinitely with cooling airflow >= 10 m/s
duty.burst: 90 A phase / 3300 W shaft for <= 30 s, followed by >= 120 s at or below continuous
